purpose: Exact paired loss bounds for overlapping persistent events with shared missing observations
authorization: User requested execution of candidate A; A-P0 is the initial research stage
data_access: Download public UCI archives; numerical research uses the fixed development prefixes below
event: At least L consecutive observed-time-grid high indicators (value >= threshold) within the next K records; not a legal warning or a claim about values between samples

predictors.constant: Laplace-smoothed training event frequency on unambiguous labels

training: One pooled model per dataset/window. Training targets must end before train_end; only logically identified labels are used. Calibration prefix is reserved and not used for selection in this pilot. No hyperparameter or threshold search.
features: Only measurements strictly before each forecast origin; causal forward-fill plus training median initialization, lag/rolling summaries, missing indicators and known calendar/station indicators.
natural_evaluation: Every complete future window in the fixed evaluation suffix; report all three model pairs, each station, and the pooled finite panel. Weekly non-overlapping panels are secondary descriptive comparisons, not independent trials.

artificial_evaluation.panel_selection: Earliest longest naturally complete run in the evaluation suffix, truncated to artificial_max_length
artificial_evaluation.rules: Hide raw measurements before recomputing causal features; freeze models. Original complete labels are used only to check bound containment, never to form predictions or choose pairs.

correctness: Brute-force enumeration, old suffix DP and compressed DP agreement; edge K=1, L=1, L=K, all missing/observed, signed coefficients, same-sign equality, explicit decision-changing example
scope: Finite-panel identification, not population confidence or a missing-value recovery claim. Novelty and real decision value are assessed separately. No UrbanEV/Paris training restart.

amendment.reason: The fixed 90-day qualification found only 8 missing measurements (2 in evaluation), with zero ambiguous natural evaluation labels. Extend the chronological prefix to 180 days to examine natural missingness; the UCI description already identifies April 2007 missingness.
amendment.interpretation: Exploratory data-qualification extension after initial results; not an untouched confirmatory replication. Preserve A-P0 outputs. No model, feature, threshold, K/L or masking selection.
